sentences.raw_text: Hi Carys, I’m setting up our new claims team and it’s taking forever to assign permissions. Each person needs a custom setup and I keep worrying I’ll miss something.
sentences.text: Hi Carys, I’m setting up our new claims team and it’s taking forever to assign permissions. Each person needs a custom setup and I keep worrying I’ll miss something.

sentences.raw_text: Could we schedule a follow-up next Tuesday? I’ll be out Wednesday and Thursday, so Tuesday works best for me.

sentences.raw_text: I hear you — it’s not ideal that we can’t clone roles. You’re right, it’s a manual process and easy to slip up, which then blocks access for handlers.
sentences.text: I hear you — it’s not ideal that we can’t clone roles. You’re right, it’s a manual process and easy to slip up, which then blocks access for handlers.

sentences.raw_text: Exactly. I just spent 45 minutes ticking boxes for one person. If I could copy an existing role, it’d save hours every week.
sentences.text: Exactly. I just spent 45 minutes ticking boxes for one person. If I could copy an existing role, it’d save hours every week.

sentences.raw_text: It’s frustrating that I can’t just duplicate an existing role — I have to manually select permissions for each new user, and if I make a mistake, it locks them out of their tasks. This permission setup duplication is eating up way too much time.
sentences.text: It’s frustrating that I can’t just duplicate an existing role — I have to manually select permissions for each new user, and if I make a mistake, it locks them out of their tasks. This permission setup duplication is eating up way too much time.

sentences.raw_text: We’re tracking this as a known pain point. For now, I can walk you through a checklist to reduce errors — or we can schedule a live session if you’d like.

sentences.raw_text: That’d be great. Let’s lock in a time — I’m swamped this week but next Tuesday after 2pm works for me.
